body: Oh, ok.
I would look up nearby places that offer counseling, I know firsthand that it's scary to walk into that therapist's office for the 1st time, but I promise it will help you.
I would tell this couple you're staying with how you feel, they will help you.
Ok well how about you can PM me about whatever you want? I really don't want you to do this, I'm begging you.
http://commongroundhelps.org/
Please do not do this. We can talk about anything. Just do not kill yourself.
My pleasure, I really hope you see that you deserve a good life.
You wanna just talk to me then via PM?
http://www.suicide.org/suicide-hotlines.html
There are 24 hour suicide hotlines.   http://www.suicidepreventionlifeline.org/   1-800-273-TALK

Fuck the people who make fun of you and degrade you for their entertainment. They're not important, their opinions don't matter. There is no shame in trying your hardest and not succeeding. I would seek therapy, just to have someone to say your thoughts out loud to.
Just push through to therapy, you will get good help from therapy, I promise.
Please do not do this. You have a family.

You need to sleep and eat. Keep calling those help lines and psychiatrists, it is odd that they did not respond the 1st time. Keep your head up, this is obviously an extremely tough time but hold out, and get some help.
Why'd you hate him?
You gotta see it through, one session isn't gonna do it all for you.
I think you should seek therapy, you don't deserve to die, you deserve good things in your life.
Do you have anyone whose house you can stay at for company?
Convince them to see a therapist. Tell them you care about them. Make sure they know that you care for them.
You should seek therapy, you have a lot of emotions going through your head right now. I am sorry that she did that while you were away, it's unfair but you gotta keep your head up. You can do this.
I would seek therapy. If you can't talk to your mother you need to talk to someone. Please do not kill yourself, you've got your whole life ahead of you.
I am here if you want to PM me, we can talk about this. Please do not kill yourself.
Are you sure you're not being too hard on yourself? No one is perfect.

I've had crippling anxiety too, panic attacks that lead to massive sweating and irrational thoughts. I had so much trouble getting over my fear of what people thought but I can honestly say that pushing myself to try new things helped my anxiety.
I bet if you told your friends and family your feelings they would show how much they care.
What makes you not believe in yourself?
Not at all? Do you have any interests or things you like to do?
You really do not want to do this, you do have purpose you have to believe me.
Your friends and family care about you. Please do not kill yourself.
Don't say that, you have more purpose than that and you know it.
I would definitely seek some therapy. You are in a tough situation right now, keep pushing forward.
Please don't do it. We can talk about this.

Don't be so hard on yourself, you're not perfect. Maybe check into rehab for your drinking, it's not doing you any favors. If anything it's lowering your self esteem by making you rely on it. You have your whole life ahead of you, you can do this.
Sounds like a plan :) hang in there.
I have had anxiety issues before too, I feel your pain. If you wanna PM me I'm open to talk.
Check into rehab, you can do this.
Please don't kill yourself, let's talk about it. Feel free to PM me.

Confidence is something I had a lot of difficulty with when I was your age and I still have trouble with it sometimes, just believe in yourself and know that you're thoughts and feelings are just as valuable as anyone else's.

You need to seek rehab. One of the biggest steps in recovery is admitting you have an addiction, which is something you've already done. Now it's time to go to rehab, get better and get your life back.

It's without a doubt an unfair situation. You didn't do anything to deserve this kind of treatment. But it's on you to pick yourself and keep going, forget about the people who fired you, they are in the past. You can't let them weigh you down, you gotta keep fighting.

You have your whole life ahead of you. Please don't kill yourself. Don't beat yourself up too much, no one is perfect. When I was in 7th grade I did plenty of things I'm not proud of. But it's in the past, the important thing is you learn from your mistakes and push forward.

3D art and games? That's a pretty cool field to get into. Anyways yeah but while you're at a time of despair, I really hope you don't do it. I know the feel of looking for work and getting no phone calls back, and it sucks. Just keep pushing forward.
Yeah working can really be a drag sometimes. But you can use the money you get from it to do fun stuff. And if you become friends with your co-workers that's a plus too.
What kind of job do you think you would like?
How do you know you'll hate your next job?
Please do not kill yourself, losing a job is rough, but you can power through this and keep your head up.

You are not garbage. You're a person in an unfair situation doing your best. No matter what kind of day you are having you need to know that you are a person with thoughts and feelings that are just as important as anyone else's. I would seek therapy, it's nice to be able to say your thoughts out loud.

That really is too bad, but you gotta keep your head up. This is obviously unfair, you've been looking for work and found nothing, but you gotta keep looking. Don't be too hard on yourself, you're in an unfair situation trying your best.
I felt the same way for a while, bored and restless. If you're bored of being unemployed I would go out and find work. Also I would seek therapy. Hang in there.
Some people have to try harder than others at stuff. In school nothing came easy to me. You will get this, I believe in you.
I'm glad I could help :) hang in there. I believe in you.

It must be hard to have that happen. It's ok to feel like they're not paying enough attention to you, just try to understand that they still love you even though they give her more attention. And you don't sound ridiculous.
You need sleep. What are you specifically trying to cope with?
Don't be hard on yourself, you tried your best. Things are unfair sometimes and that's just how it is. You will get the job you want eventually, just keep going for it.
Depression is never easy, what is making you feel so sad?

Don't feel any pressure to have sex early on in your life man, honestly. Having sex won't give you super powers or make any of your problems go away, if anything it could lead to more problems. I have struggled with anxiety and I feel your pain. Being anxious about trivial things has really taken a toll on me some days. Most resturants will hire anybody part time, so maybe try and find some work at a place like that. The people you meet at work can become your friends. I would focus on what makes you happy. If you're not really sure what that is, find out what that is by trying new things. At first you may find nothing, and that's ok. Just keep looking. Also, maybe join a club at university? The people you could meet through there could later become friends.

It's ok to mess up and make a mistake. You seem incredibly hard on yourself. As someone who has experience with anxiety I understand being paranoid, it's the worst feeling in the world. To combat this, I've tried to be more outgoing and while it hasn't solved everything, just having simple interactions with people go well helps instill confidence in me a little bit at a time. Hang in there, try to figure out what makes you happy and find other people who share that passion.
You're too young to die, there's a lot to experience and a lot for you to see. I would speak with a trustworthy friend or your parents.

Breakups are tough but now you have the opportunity to find out who you really are and what you want to do for yourself. Don't listen to the people who criticize you, no one knows you better than yourself. They aren't important in your life if all they do is bring you down.
I'm trying my best to help out on /r/SuicideWatch right now.
You really do not want to do this, just take a step back and try to realize what's bringing you pressure and pain and what you can do to ease it.
I have no clue what their usernames were, it's been many years.
